date_note: LaLiga disclosed the attack in a press release dated 23 November; the release says the unauthorised access took place between 14 and 16 November.
title: LaLiga says cyberattack on a fan-services platform took personal data of registered users
geo_basis: headquarters of LaLiga (Madrid); the release gives no location for the platform
summary: LaLiga said on 23 November that a cybercriminal illegitimately accessed one of its technology platforms for fan services between 14 and 16 November and extracted personal data of users registered in digital services of LaLiga and some clubs. According to LaLiga, the attack was contained on 16 November, the incident was limited to this platform, and it was reported to Spain's data protection agency (AEPD) and the National Police's Central Cybercrime Unit.
plain: LaLiga says a cybercriminal got into one of its fan-services platforms from 14 to 16 November and took personal data of registered users of LaLiga and some clubs.
exec: LaLiga says registered users' personal data was taken from one fan-services platform; it reported the incident to the AEPD and the police.

evidence.quote: LALIGA sufrió entre el 14 y el 16 de noviembre un ciberataque

validation.note: Primary source: LaLiga's own press release (laliga.com, 23 Nov), read. Marca, AS and Mundo Deportivo also reported it but refused automated readers and were not read. The release names no clubs, gives no number of users and does not list the data fields taken; LaLiga says it is still analysing the scope.

review.note: Compared title, dates 14-16 Nov, containment 16 Nov, AEPD and Policia Nacional report, scope and published date 23 Nov against LaLiga's own press release; evidence quote found; no advice given so action is fine
